notes.title: Be the FIRST to play Tyrant's Twilight!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! For this month’s update I’m excited to announce an open beta for Tyrant’s Twilight!
The game will be playable from December 8th, 10am EST until December 11th.
You can subscribe now to the beta by clicking the Request Access button right under the game’s trailer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476777/54a8a6cc7d7ca68dca008cf9fd94df714b3f75d5.gif[/img]


See you there!

notes.title: Meet the cast of Tyrant's Twilight! (so far...)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! In this month's update I'd like to share some details about 3 out of the 8 planned playable characters for Tyrant's Twilight. All the art was made by khadarsensei, check out his [url=https://www.deviantart.com/khadarsensei]deviantart[/url]!
Without further ado, here they are!

[b]Alanna[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476777/3f83f82236e4f6cceb3e4e73f971f01ac08503fa.jpg[/img]
An only-daughter of a small noble family, Alanna was always more interested in her bow and arrow than any of her duties as a lady. 
Alanna married the lord of house Aelfrum in an arrangement made by her father to strengthen both houses. 
Her husband lost the movement on his legs as a young man, and because of it, even though unusual for this world, Alanna is the defacto military commander of house Aelfrum.
Before the game begins, Alanna's brother is chosen as the Warrior Saint who's prophecized to rid the world of the encroching army of the Tyrant God. Alanna joins his army to fight the spreading darkness, but her brother is defeated and the hope for humanity seems lost.
The game’s story begins as a wounded Alanna drags herself away from the battlefield to find what's left of her family and escape the Tyrant's army.


[b]Damon[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476777/e81179e5c42733969f9705e582b70cd9cf837ec3.jpg[/img]
Youngest son between 5 brothers, Damon always knew he would never inherit the seat of his noble house and, from a very young age, dedicated himself to becoming a knight.
Despite showing great promise with a sword, Damon was never knighted by the church for lacking the necessary “knightly virtues”. 
Beause of this, he became a mercenary and was eventually hired by Alanna’s father to train the young girl who was only 12 at the time.
Since then, Damon has been the right hand man for Alanna and joined the ranks of house Aelfrum when she became their leader.
Damon’s personality is playful, not easily swayed by minor setbacks, but during battle, he’s cold and pragmatic, striving for victory above all else.


[b]Safiya[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44476777/214aa24b4b9c5ae6b5184a1cc2b43d997f276ff9.jpg[/img]
Safiya is a young orphan and a descendant of the people of the Lost Continent, the place where the Tyrant God rests with his army.
After accidentally coming into contact with a relic dropped off by one of the Tyrant's monsters, Safiya discovers a dorment ability to wield magic. A feat that had passed onto legend ever since her homeland was taken by the Tyrant, thousands of years ago.
The relic is fused with her body and can only be removed if she's killed.
With her new found skill, Safiya becomes a new symbol of hope for humanity, but also a target for those who think her relic could be put to better use on more experienced soldiers.


These are all the characters I have to show for today. 
If you're excited to learn more about them in the future, don't forget to wishlist and follow Tyrant's Twilight!
